title: Facil — Canal Mobile vs Web vs Inspector

list.name: workflow
list.label: Workflow
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT workflow_code FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE workflow_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY workflow_code

list.name: entity
list.label: Entité
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT entity_code FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE entity_code IS NOT NULL ORDER BY entity_code

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE channel='mobile' AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE channel='web' AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring})

SELECT count(*) FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE channel='inspector' AND created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring})

SELECT workflow_code AS workflow, count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='mobile') AS "Mobile", count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='web') AS "Web", count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='inspector') AS "Inspector", count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='unknown') AS "Unknown" FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY workflow_code ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT channel, count(*) AS n FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY channel ORDER BY n DESC

SELECT channel AS "Canal", payment_method AS "Méthode", SUM(total_amount) AS "Total", count(*) AS "Nombre" FROM v_service_payments_enriched WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY channel, payment_method ORDER BY "Total" DESC NULLS LAST
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM v_service_payments_enriched WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='mobile') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*), 0))::numeric(10,2) FROM v_service_payments_enriched WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()

SELECT channel AS "Canal", payment_status AS "Statut", count(*) AS "Nombre", SUM(total_amount) AS "Total" FROM v_service_payments_enriched WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() GROUP BY channel, payment_status ORDER BY "Total" DESC NULLS LAST

SELECT date_trunc('day', created_at) AS time, count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='mobile') AS "Mobile", count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='web') AS "Web", count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='inspector') AS "Inspector", count(*) FILTER (WHERE channel='unknown') AS "Unknown" FROM v_service_requests_channel WHERE created_at BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() AND workflow_code IN (${workflow:sqlstring}) AND entity_code IN (${entity:sqlstring}) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
